# Ahmed Abu Qahf (som3aware)

> Full-stack engineer. Product-minded. Design-driven.

Portfolio of a senior full-stack engineer. The site is a keyboard-driven terminal-style workspace; every section is also readable as one plain page at https://som3aware.pages.dev/?plain. Full text: https://som3aware.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## projects

- [Stayro](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/stayro) (2025–26): Guest and host mobile apps for stays in Saudi Arabia.
- [Hivo](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/hivo) (2025–26): Mobile-first rental marketplace for Saudi Arabia.
- [Reconciled](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/reconciled) (2024–25): Invoice reconciliation platform for staffing agencies.
- [Outlined AI](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/outlined-ai) (2023): AI mobile app that turns audio and video into structured notes.
- [Sharp Studio](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/sharp-studio) (2024): Hackable image processing: convert, resize and compress.
- [Editor Setup](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/editor-setup) (2025): Curated VS Code font and theme pairings.
- [Open Trivia](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/open-trivia) (2024): Multi-round trivia game on the Open Trivia API.
- [Covid Tracker](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/covid-tracker) (2023): App to track COVID patients.
- [Storefront API](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/storefront-api) (2022): Node API for a store.
